title: Can I BEAT Stockfish with a Secret Queen?
summary: Tony vs Fairy-Stockfish where one of his pawns is secretly a queen, chosen by spinning a wheel of pawn squares. It moves like a pawn until he makes a 'suspicious' (queen-only) move, at which point it is revealed as a queen to the engine. Game 1 (f2 secret queen): Nf3-e5, then the f2 'pawn' takes on f7 for mate (~2:36). Game 2 (f2 removed from wheel, b2 chosen): b3, Nf3-e5, reveal and Qxf7# (~4:36).
rules: Before each game a spinner wheel picks one of the player's pawns to be the secret queen (game 2 removed f2 from the wheel; wheel showed b2,c2,d2,e2,g2,h2 etc.).
The secret queen looks like a pawn; the engine treats it as a pawn.
The player may move it like a queen at any time; when it makes a non-pawn move it is revealed and becomes a normal queen.
win_condition: Checkmate Fairy-Stockfish (won both games quickly via Qxf7#).
